answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk forgery. An agent locks a 120-coin bond, twice its 30-day earnings; it loses 5% each epoch, so an idle identity dies in 20 epochs. Renewal is no ivory trophy: it needs verified work plus one original sonnet. Honest trade is a river of deals; fakes are a flood. Forging 1,000 identities costs 120,000 coins plus 1,000 renewals, above their diluted split. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps rewards undiluted.
